function Slovom(Cislo: real; Rod: real): string;              
var s1: string='jednosto';                                    
    s2: string='dvesto';

    jm4: string='çtyri';                                      
    jm5: string='p„œ';

    jm16: string='çestn sœ';                                  
    jm17: string='sedemn sœ';

    jm40: string='çtyridsaœ';

    jm80: string='osemdesiat';                                
    jm90: string='dev„desiat';                                
    sC,mil,ssm,sdm,mm,sl1,tis,sst,sdt,sl2,jed,ssj,sdj,sl3,jj1,jj2: string;
    Vm,sm,dm,jm,Vt,st,dt,jt,Vj,sj,dj,jj,des : real;           
                                                              
begin                                                         
   jm2:=jm2+cond(Rod=1: 'e', else: 'a');                      
   jj1:=cond(Rod=0: 'jeden', Rod=1: 'jedna', else: 'jedno');  
   jj2:=cond(Rod=0: 'dva', else: 'dve');                      
   sC:=str(abs(Cislo),11,1);                                  
   des:=frac(Cislo);                                          
   mil:=copy(sC,1,3);                                         
   Vm:=val(mil);                                              
   sm:=val(copy(mil,1,1));                                    
  ssm:=cond(sm=1: s1, sm=2: s2, sm=3: s3, sm=4: s4, sm=5: s5,

   jm:=val(copy(mil,3,1));                                    
  sdm:=cond(dm=1: jm1,   dm=2: jm2,   dm=3: jm3,   dm=4: jm4,   dm=5: jm5,

function Ret(r : string; c1 : real): string; begin            
Ret:=copy(r,pos(',',r,,c1)+1,pos(',',r,,c1+1)-1-pos(',',r,,c1)); end;
                                                              
function Dop0(r : string): string; begin Dop0 := r;           
if length(r)=10 then exit; while length(r)<10 do r:='0'+r; Dop0 := r; end;

function medz(r : string): string; var x:real; begin medz := '';
for x:=1 to 50 do begin medz := medz + copy(r, x, 1) + ' '; end; end;

 P  pOkno       
                  {proc(okno,('\1',7,3,72,13,'\178'));}       
(x:string;a:real;b:real;c:real;d:real;e:string)               
var a1, b1, cas, f, g, h, i, j, k, l:real; interval:real=00:00:02;
begin a1:=(a+c)/2; b1:=(b+d)/2; j:=a1-a; k:=b1-b;             { PROC okno NIE JE DORIESENA     }
  if j>k then begin f:=1; g:=0; l:=0;                         {                                }
  end else begin                                              {                                }
    if j=k then begin f:=1; g:=1; l:=1;                       { farba, x1, y1, x2, y2, znak    }
    end else begin f:=0; g:=1; l:=2;                          {                                }
    end;                                                      {   (x1,y1)ÄÄÄÄÄÄÄÄÄÄÄÄÄÄÄÄÄÄÄ¿  }
  end;                                                        {    ³                        ³  }
  repeat h:=(b1-g);                                           {    ÀÄÄÄÄÄÄÄÄÄÄÄÄÄÄÄÄÄÄÄ(x2,y2) }
    repeat gotoxy(a1-f,h); write(x+repeatstr(e,2*f)); h:=h+1; until h-1>b1+g;
    if l=0 then begin f:=2*f; g:=g+1;                         
    end else begin                                            
      if l=1 then begin f:=f+1; g:=g+1;                       
      end else begin f:=f+1; g:=2*g; end;                     
    end;                                                      
  until (f>j)|(g>k); l:=d-b;                                  
  repeat gotoxy(a,b); write(x+repeatstr(e,c-a)); delay(2000); l:=l+1; b:=b+1;
  until l>d;                                                  
END;

 P  pDoSpotr_Zpd
var c, x, br : real; nazov, rok : string; sp : record of spotreba;
begin readrec(sp, edrecno);                                   
  proc(pVytvorCat); c := pos('DELF',pd.path);                 
  nazov := copy(pd.path,1,c-1); rok := copy(pd.path,c+4,4); ResetCatalog;
{  gotoxy(5,5); writeln(pd.path); write(nazov,'             ',rok); delay(50000);}
  if ParamCat.Rok <> val(strdate(sp.datum,'YYYY')) then       
    forall c in Catalog (upcase(nazsouboru)=~'PD') % do begin 
      Catalog[c].Cesta := nazov+'DELF'+strdate(sp.datum,'YYYY')+'\'+
                          trailchar(' ',Catalog[c].NazSouboru)+'.000';
      Catalog[c].Navesti := ' ';                              
    end; ResetCatalog;                                        
    x:=1; while sp.datum>pd[x].a & x<PD.nrecs do x += 1;      
    edit(PD, ePDbrowse, mode='#L!!^y^n', recno=x, irec=10, cond=(vydaj='2'),
         head=' DATOVí EDITOR                    Riadok Ÿ¡slo ____                    __.__.__',
         last='  Prenos £dajov do spotreby :  F3servis  F4oprava  F5invest¡cie  F6in‚',
           ww=(1,3,80,24,' PD - '+strdate(sp.datum,'YYYY')+' ',^B,^S,^E,^A), ctrl='',
         exit=(F2,F7,F8,CtrlF7,CtrlF4:pPrazdna,               
               F3,F4,F5,F6:quit)); br:=edbreak;               
  if br>22 & br<27 then begin x:=edrecno;                     
    c:=recno(Spotreba/iDat_, PAR.kod, pd[x].a); if c>0 then c:=c else c:=abs(c);
    if c<=spotreba.nrecs then readrec(sp,c) else exit;        
    if br=23 then sp.servis += pd[x].a2+pd[x].a4;             
    if br=24 then sp.oprava += pd[x].a2+pd[x].a4;             
    if br=25 then sp.invest += pd[x].a2+pd[x].a4;             
    if br=26 then sp.ine    += pd[x].a2+pd[x].a4;             
    sp.popis := cond(sp.popis<>~'' : trailchar(' ',sp.popis)+' * ')+
                     pd[x].d; writerec(sp,c);                 
  end;                                                        
  if ParamCat.Rok <> val(strdate(sp.datum,'YYYY')) then       
    forall c in Catalog (upcase(nazsouboru)=~'PD') % do begin 
      Catalog[c].Cesta := nazov+'DELF'+ strdate(ParamCat.Rok,'YYYY')+'\'+
                          trailchar(' ',Catalog[c].NazSouboru)+'.000';
      Catalog[c].Navesti := ' ';                              
    end; ResetCatalog; setkeybuf('\0\95');                    
end;

 P  pKonSpotreba
                                                              
(s : record of Spotreba) var pomer : real;                    
begin { spotr := ( litre / km ) * 100 }                       
  pomer := cond (SpotPrie[1].uspora > 0 &                     
                 SpotPrie[1].spotr_posled > SpotPrie[1].spotr_lpg :
                 1 / (SpotPrie[1].spotr_lpg / SpotPrie[1].spotr_posled),
                 SpotPrie[1].uspora = 0 &                     
                 SpotPrie[1].spotr_posled > SpotPrie[1].spotr :
                 1 / (SpotPrie[1].spotr / SpotPrie[1].spotr_posled),
                 else : 1);                                   
  SpotPrie[1].koniec_km :=                                    
    SpotPrie[1].zacia_km + (pomer * ( s.litre /               
           cond (SpotPrie[1].uspora = 0 : SpotPrie[1].spotr, else : SpotPrie[1].spotr_lpg) * 100));
end;

 P  pSp_Auto_Opr
                                                              
var x, y : real=2; E,A : record of Spotreba;                  
begin merge(['#I1_Spotreba/iDat #O1_Spotreba']); if Spotreba.nrecs < 1 then exit;
  forall x in Spotreba/iKodA (key in [(par.kod)]) ! % do begin
    readrec(E, x-1); readrec(A, x); y := A.km;                
    if E.koniec_km <> A.zacia_km & e.kod=a.kod then A.zacia_km := E.koniec_km;
    A.koniec_km := y + cond(e.kod=a.kod : E.koniec_km, else : A.zacia_km);
    if x>1 then writerec(A, x);                               
  end;                                                        
end;

 P  pZmenKodVyd 
                                                              
(p:record of Vydaje) var q:record of Vydaje; c,x,y : real;    
begin gotoxy(5,5); readrec(q, edrecno);                       
  write(p.kod,' ',q.kod); delay(55555555);                    
  if p.kod<>q.kod then begin                                  
    PARAM.doklad := q.kod; save; close; write(' ',PARAM.doklad); delay(55555555);
    if recno(Vydaje/@, p.kod)>0 | recno(Vydaje/@, p.kod)>0 then exit;
    for x := 1991 to val(strdate(today,'YYYY')) do begin writeln(x:4);
      forall c in Catalog % do begin                          
        Catalog[c].Cesta := 'd:\fand\ju\delf'+str(x,4,0)+'\'+trailchar(' ',Catalog[c].NazSouboru)+'.000';
        Catalog[c].Navesti := ' ';                            
      end; sort(Catalog, (~NazUlohy,~NazSouboru)); ResetCatalog; close;
      forall y in PD (vydaj=PARAM.doklad & (a2>0 | a4>0)) ! % do begin
        PD[y].vydaj:=p.kod; close;                            
      end;                                                    
      forall y in KZ (vydaj=PARAM.doklad) ! % do begin        
        KZ[y].vydaj:=p.kod; close;                            
      end;                                                    
    end;                                                      
  end;                                                        
end;

        EZ[y].prijem:=p.kod; close;                           
      end;                                                    
    end;                                                      
  end;

    pZmenKodKpKz
var x,c : real;                                               
begin                                                         
  forall c in KP ! % do begin close;                          
    if KP[c].prijem='1' then KP[c].prijem:='S';               
    if KP[c].prijem='p' then KP[c].prijem:='T';               
    if KP[c].prijem='r' then KP[c].prijem:='R';               
    if KP[c].prijem='x' then KP[c].prijem:='X';               
    if KP[c].prijem='z' then KP[c].prijem:='Z';               
  end;                                                        
  forall c in EZ ! % do begin close;                          
    if EZ[c].prijem='1' then EZ[c].prijem:='S';               
    if EZ[c].prijem='p' then EZ[c].prijem:='T';               
    if EZ[c].prijem='r' then EZ[c].prijem:='R';               
     ,_ if EZ[c].prijem='x' then EZ[c].prijem:='X';           
    if EZ[c].prijem='z' then EZ[c].prijem:='Z';               
  end;                                                        
  forall c in KZ ! % do begin close;                          
    if KZ[c].vydaj='T' then KZ[c].vydaj:='t';                 
  end;                                                        
end;

 P  pVypisCislo 
                                                              
(U : record of ucet) var m,r,n : real;                        
begin m := val(strdate(u.d,'MM')); r := val(strdate(u.d,'YYYY'));
  if u.d < valdate('12.09.2003','DD.MM.YYYY') then begin      
    if val(strdate(u.d,'DD'))>11 then begin                   
      u.a := valdate('11.'+ cond(m=12 : '01', else : str(m+1,'00'))+
             '.' + cond(m=12 : str(r+1,'0000'), else : str(r,'0000')),'DD.MM.YYYY');
      u.b := cond(m=12 : '1', else : str(m+1,'00'));          
    end else begin                                            
      u.a := valdate('11.'+ str(m,'00')+'.'+ str(r,'0000'),'DD.MM.YYYY');
      u.b := str(m,'00');                                     
    end;                                                      
  end else begin                                              
    param.dat2 := addmonth(u.d,1); save;                      
    param.dat2 := valdate('01.'+strdate(param.dat2,'MM.YYYY'),'DD.MM.YYYY'); save;
    param.dat2 := param.dat2 - 1;                             
    u.a := valdate(strdate(param.dat2,'DD.')+ str(m,'00')+'.'+ 
                   str(r,'0000'),'DD.MM.YYYY');               
    if u.d < valdate('01.01.2004','DD.MM.YYYY') then u.b := str(m+1,'00')
                                                else u.b := str(m,'00');
  end;                                                        
end;

    pPDprerus_B 
{ Spracovanie preruseni editacie PD}                          
var prerus, i, pocet, f:real; zzz:string; d, e:boolean;       
    uc : record of UCET; den : record of PD;                  
begin                                                         
  if UCET.nrecs>0 then Param.UC := val(ucet[UCET.nrecs].b)+1 else Param.UC := 1;
  repeat                                                      
    if ^d then                                                
      edit(UCET, eUCET, mode='F201', recno=UCET.nrecs, ctrl='',
           head=' DATOVí EDITOR              Edit cia nov‚ho bankov‚ho vìpisu           __.__.__',
           last=' Alt  F1Platba F2éhrada od F3Prenos do PD F8Ban.vìpisy F95x <Ù   EscBez prenosu',
            alt=' Alt  F1Prenos z existuj£ceho vìpisu',       
             ww=(1,4,80,24,='',^S,^B,^E,^B),                  
           EXIT=(F1,F2:pBanka_Ucel, AltF1,F3:QUIT, F8:pBeznyUcet, F9:pEnter_5))
    else                                                      
      edit(Ucet, eUcet, mode='^n^y', ctrl='',                 
           head=' DATOVí EDITOR                        Vìpis Ÿ. ___                     __.__.__',
           last=' Alt  F1Platba F2éhrada od F3Prenos do PD F8Ban.vìpisy    EscBez prenosu',
            alt=' Alt  F1Vytvor novì vìpis',                  
           ww=(1,4,80,24,='',^S,^B,^E,^B),                    
           exit=(F4,F7,CtrlF7,CtrlF4:pPrazdna, AltF1,F3:QUIT, F8:pBeznyUcet, F1,F2:pBanka_Ucel));
    if edbreak=41 then d := ^d;

 P  pHladac     
{}                                                            
var s: string;                                                
begin                                                         
  repeat s:=readkey;                                          
    case                                                      
      Ord(s)=27 | Ord(s)=13 | Ord(s)=0 :                      
       begin                      {vyŸist¡m buffry}           
        param.NameSearch:=''; param.NSearch:=0;               
        clrscr(1,25,40,25);       {plynule prejde zo zad vania}
        if ord(s)=0 then begin    {do listovania pod–a kurzor. kl ves}
          ClearKeyBuf; SetKeyBuf(s);                          
        end; PARAM.ok:=true; exit;                            
       end;                                                   
      Ord(s)=8 :                  {delete char}               
       if length(Trailchar(' ',param.NameSearch))>0 then begin
         param.NSearch:=param.NSearch-1;                      
         param.NameSearch:= copy(param.NameSearch,1,param.NSearch);
       end;                                                   
      Ord(s)>31 :                                             
       begin                                                  
         param.NameSearch:=copy(param.NameSearch,1,param.NSearch)+s;
         param.NSearch+=1;                                    
       end;                                                   
    else PARAM.ok:=true; exit; end; write(s);                 
  until ^KeyPressed;                                          
end;

 P  pMemDisk    
                                                              
var x,y:real; disks : file [ disk : A,5; velkost : F,8,0; volne : F,8,0;
                             #C volne_S := cond(disk=~'': '', else : str(volne,8,0)):A,8 ];
    eDatum, eDisky:string;  d : record of disks;              
begin                                                         
  disks.nrecs:=0; y:=0;                                       
  d.disk := 'Pam„œ'; d.volne := MemAvail/1024; writerec(d,0); 
  for x:=ord('C') to ord('Z') do                              
    if diskfree(char(x))<>-1 then begin                       
      d.disk := '    '+char(x); d.volne := diskfree(char(x))/1024; writerec(d,0);
      y+=1;                                                   
    end;                                                      
  eDisky := '#_Disks disk, volne_S;\13 _____ : ________ kB'; y+=1;
  edit ( disks, [eDisky], mode='!!^n^y',                      
     last=' F1                                                                         Esc',
     head=' DATOVí EDITOR                   Konfigur cia programu                 __.__.__',
     ww=(12,5,34,6+y,=' Vo–n‚ : '!,^E,^E,^E,^E),              
     exit=(F2,F3,F4,F5,F6,F7,CtrlF7,AltF7:pPrazdna));         
  disks.nrecs:=0;                                             
end;

    if ink.el_rok=2010 then ink.sk_v := 5.30;                 
    if ink.el_rok=2010 then ink.pausal := 332.6;              
    if ink.el_rok>2010 then ink.dph := 20;

                (AktCas):pVyberObchod));

 P  pZmenObchod 
                                                              
(n_o : record of Nakup_o) var x:real; n_t : record of Nakup_t;
begin proc(pVyberObchod);                                     
  forall x in n_t owner n_o ! do begin                        
    n_t.kod_o := param.cislo; writerec(n_t, x);               
  end;                                                        
  n_o.kod_o := param.cislo;                                   
end;

 P  pSumNakRataj
                                                              
var n_t : record of Nakup_t;                                  
begin param.a1:=0; param.a2:=0;                               
  forall n_t/@ (key in [param.a1234]) do begin                
    param.a1+=n_t.spolu; param.a2+=n_t.bez_dph;               
  end;                                                        
end;                                                          

 P  pVyberObchod
                                                              
var x,y,z : real=1; vyber : boolean=false; o : record of obchody;
    n_t : record of Nakup_t;                                  
begin if edfile<>~'JU' then vyber:=true; param.cislo:=0;      
  if ^vyber then forall x in o ! % do begin param.a1:=0; param.a2:=0;
    o.spolu:=0; o.bez_dph:=0;                                 
    forall n_t/iObch (key in [o.kod]) do begin                
      param.a1+=n_t.spolu; param.a2+=n_t.bez_dph;             
    end; o.spolu:=param.a1; o.bez_dph:=param.a2; writerec(o,x);
  end;                                                        
  if obchody.nrecs=0 then setkeybuf('\0\60');                 
  edit(obchody/@, eObchody, mode='^y', RECNO=x, irec=10,      
       head=' DATOVí EDITOR                    Obchod Ÿ¡slo ____                    __.__.__',
       last='              F2Novì obchod'+                    
            cond(vyber:' F3Vìber obchodu', else: '               ')+
            '        F9H–adaj    Esc',                        
       ctrl='', ww=(13,3,79,24,'',^B,^S,^E,^A),               
       exit=(CtrlF4,F10,F1,F7,F8,CtrlF6,CtrlF9,CtrlF10,AltF1:pPrazdna,
             F9:pHla_PD, F3:quit, (nazov):pVyberMesto, newrec:pKodObchodu));
  x:=edbreak; if x=23 then param.cislo:=obchody[edrecno].kod; save; close;
end;

 P  pNovyTovar  

begin merge(['#I1_ Tovary #O1_tovary mj:=upcase(mj)']);

           exit=(CtrlF4,F10,F1,F2,F3,F7,F8,CtrlF6,CtrlF9,CtrlF10,AltF1:pPrazdna,
                 F9:pHla_t, record:pZrusenieTov)); exit;      
    end else repeat setkeybuf('\0\67');

                 F9:pHla_t, CtrlF2,F2,F3,F7:quit, record:pZrusenieTov));
      x:=edbreak; y:=edrecno; readrec(Tov, y); close;         
      if x=32 then begin x := 0; while recno(Tovary/@, x)>0 do x += 1;

                  (mj):pKodTovaru));

  if y>0 then begin param.NameSearch:=copy(tovary[i].d,1,3); setkeybuf('\0\67'+' ');
    edit(tovary/iTovar, etovary, mode='!!^y^n', RECNO=i, irec=10, cond=(kod<>z),
         head=' DATOVí EDITOR                     Tovar Ÿ¡slo ____                    __.__.__',
         last='              F3Vìber tovaru, ktorì nahrad¡ existuj£ce polo§ky v n kupoch   Esc',
         ctrl='', ww=(11,3,79,24,'',^E,^S,^E,^A),             
         exit=(CtrlF4,F10,F1,F2,F7,F8,CtrlF6,CtrlF9,CtrlF10,AltF1:pPrazdna,
               F9:pHla_t, F3:quit));                          
    if edbreak=23 then begin y:=tovary[edrecno].kod;          
      forall x in n_t/iNt (key in [z]) ! % do begin           
        n_t.kod_t := y; writerec(n_t, x);                     
      end;                                                    
    end else edok:=false;                                     
  end; setkeybuf('\0\95');                                    
end;                                                          

 P  pZrusDruhTov
                                                              
var i, x, y : real=0; to:record of Tovary; z : string;        
begin i:=edrecno; z:=DruhTova[i].b;                           
  if edbreak=17 then forall x in to (kod_d=z) % do y+=1;      
  if y>0 then edok:=false; setkeybuf('\0\95');                
end;                                                          

 P  pKodTovaru  
                                                              
(tov : record of Tovary) var x : real=1;                      
begin close; while recno(Tovary/@, x)>0 do x += 1; tov.kod := x;
  setkeybuf('\0\60');                                         
  edit(param, e, mode='??01', last='',                        
       head=' DATOVí EDITOR                     Tovar Ÿ¡slo ____                    __.__.__',
       ctrl='', ww=(23,4,24,5,@,^B,^B,^B),     { ^B,^S,^E,^A), }
       exit=(F2:pDruhTovaru)); close;                         
  if param.doklad<>'0' then begin tov.kod_d := param.doklad;  
    tov.dph := param.dph; setkeybuf('\13\13');                
  end;                                                        
end;
